_about: Which YouTube apps Encore asks for songs, tried in order (after these, the built-in VISIONOS). Every installed Encore reads this file from GitHub when it starts, so a fix here reaches users without a release. Only clientName, clientId, clientVersion, userAgent, deviceMake, deviceModel, osName and osVersion are used. yt-dlp's youtube/_base.py lists the clients that work.
